Author: DriftlessDigits
Name: Balamb Garden
Description: Gardening companion: stand by your garden and water, harvest, or replant a whole patch - or every ripe pot in the house - with one button, at a patient human pace. Keeps a ledger of what's planted where, when you watered it, and when it will be ripe (down to the afternoon). A Yields tab counts what you planted and gathered per crop, and how often each cross took. /garden to open.
Changelog: Every sowing now records what the other beds in that patch were growing at that moment, and which soil went in, so crosses that took or missed can be explained later (pots record their soil). It reads the game's own sow question to learn the soil and never clicks anything. Fixed: Forget record and Run cycle now work on the second click; Water All no longer leaves the last pot showing wilting; Tend All no longer stalls on a bed it can't target. A bed the cycle just replanted no longer briefly asks "replanted without me?". The run log names everything a harvest gave, crop and seed.
